verdict.rationale: DeepSeek documents a public API compatible with the OpenAI and Anthropic formats, plus the OpenAI Responses format. The docs cover streaming, function calling, JSON output, rate limits and concurrency, error codes, and model lifecycle notices with advance deprecation dates. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the first-party API directly (community usage cited is mostly via OpenRouter or about cost).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The DeepSeek API uses an API format compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic. By modifying the configuration, you can use the OpenAI/Anthropic SDK or softwares compatible with the OpenAI/Anthropic API to access the DeepSeek API.
The DeepSeek API now natively supports the OpenAI Responses API format
A maintained function-calling guide with runnable OpenAI-format examples (stream or non-stream) — tool use is a documented first-class capability of the API.
you can set the `stream` parameter to `true` to get stream response
